reasons.action: The request explicitly asks for a new behavior — the car rolling forward — which is a performed action and therefore request-governed, overriding any static pose in the supplied plate.
reasons.medium: Rendering permission was already settled as preserve with an empty requested style and no observed reference medium; the medium owner remains pinned to the reference and no restyling is authorized.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is named and no actual reference observation was supplied, so there is no observed attire for the reference to govern.
reasons.lighting: The request contains no instruction about light, an illuminating source, its direction or quality, and no reference lighting reading was supplied; nothing licenses the reference to own lighting.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is requested; the canvas ratio, duration and the car's forward motion are not framing instructions, and no framing reading was observed.
reasons.palette: No color, saturation or tonal-contrast grade is requested and no reference palette reading exists, so the scene's palette stays request-governed rather than reference-derived.
